name: clock_adjtime
description: The clock_adjtime() system call adjusts the specified clock using parameters from a timex structure. It reads and optionally sets kernel clock adjustment parameters based on the modes field.

parameters.name: clk_id
parameters.description: The ID of the clock to adjust.

parameters.name: buf
parameters.description: Pointer to a timex structure containing adjustment parameters and modes.

return_value.success: Returns the clock state (e.g., TIME_OK, TIME_INS)
return_value.failure: Returns -1 and sets errno on error

errors.description: buf does not point to writable memory.
The clk_id is invalid, or parameters are out of range.
The device represented by clk_id has disappeared.
The given clk_id does not support adjustment.
